answer: A private pilot certificate makes each extra identity pay $13,000, the 2026 average; a farm running N fakes pays N×$13,000 and cannot share it because one certificate number goes to one person after 40 logged flight hours, a medical exam, and a checkride only the holder can fly. A farm reusing one certificate dies by FAA airman registry check at 2: the second filing voids both seats. Training flights wander over a ridge and a reef on the 150-nautical-mile solo cross-country, and 500 seats need 500 pilots: $6.5 million before one fake earns.
